title: microlepia marginalis var. calvescens
intro: Microlepia marginalis var. calvescens, commonly known as "Calvescens Fern," is a species of plant in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a type of fern used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Philippines, where it is valued for its various health benefits. The plant is said to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of Calvescens Fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiproliferative effects.
